No bug that makes the result meaningless. The SVR is fit on the out-of-fold residuals of LightGBM, and its prediction is added to the prediction of LightGBM trained on all the training data. That is a valid residual-stacking setup. One small mismatch: the full-data LightGBM fits the training set more closely than the out-of-fold models did, so the residual correction may be slightly off in size. This is a modelling choice, not a bug.
Cost: each fit now trains LightGBM 5 extra times, so a job takes longer. It should still fit well inside the 10-minute limit.
Recomputed z from rounded values, using noise sd 0.0037: (0.3653 - 0.3687) / (0.0037 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) = -0.0034 / 0.00453 ≈ -0.75. This matches the harness value of -0.743 within rounding.

The candidate scores worse than the incumbent (0.3687 vs 0.3653), and the difference is within noise. The provisional reject is consistent with the numbers. The candidate also changes two things at once: it switches the SVR to fitting residuals and lowers C from 3 to 1. From this result you can't tell which change caused what.
